Overview: Mid-market fintech R&D org exploring Redwood for customer chat, doc summarization, and embedding-backed risk signals. High potential ARR but POC never started.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2024-09-12: Initial inbound via partner intro (seeded by payments platform). AE Maya Patel assigned.
- 2024-10-05: Intro call — discussed typical latency SLOs (target <200ms tail for chat), regulatory constraints (data residency + audit logs).
- 2024-11-02: Security questionnaire submitted (see drive doc). Aurora asks for HSM-backed key control and ISO27001 evidence.
- 2025-03-18: Architecture workshop with SE Jordan Kim. Demo of dedicated routing and VPC private option. Aurora liked model routing ideas.
- 2025-05-02: Security deep-dive (Ruth, Aurora sec) — heavy pushback on third-party KMS; asked for on-prem KMS/HSM or strict customer-owned key.
- 2025-06-18: Product/POC scoping call. Attempted to agree success criteria. Parties could not align on resource allocation: Aurora could not commit infra engineer for 8-week POC and procurement insisted on fixed scope.
- 2025-07-09: Procurement flagged overall vendor spend freeze for rest of FY25.
- 2025-09-30: Final check-in; customer confirms vendor selection leaned to Anthropic for hosted chat and in-house embeddings for sensitive flows.

Key friction points / why POC not started:
- Security: customer insisted on HSM + CA sign-off; their deadline to close security gating slipped several times. Redwood's documented KMS path would have required additional compliance artifacts and an HSM deployment option they couldn't commit to quickly.
- Resourcing: Aurora could not dedicate an SRE/infra owner for the POC window; their ML lead was promoted and replacement bandwidth unavailable.
- Procurement / budget: company imposed a vendor spend freeze in Q3; even with favorable pricing, legal/procurement would not process new contracts.
- Misaligned success criteria: Redwood proposed measurable evals (latency p95, token cost reductions via batching, accuracy on 3 business prompts). Aurora wanted broader business KPIs (CSAT delta, fraud false positive delta) but had no instrumentation plan for POC.

Sales notes / quotes:
- "We need to see an HSM path or it's a non-starter" — Aurora security lead (May 2025).
- "Can't commit people — hiring freeze killed our timeline" — Aurora ML manager (July 2025).

Outcome: Closed-lost (Champion left + budget freeze + security blockers). No POC executed. Deal archived.

- Target next budget cycle: Jan 2026 / Q1 2026 outreach (note procurement freeze may lift Q1 2026).
- Prepare a focused HSM/KMS runbook and a scoped 4-week smoke-test POC that requires minimal Aurora SRE time (bootstrap scripts, demo infra).
